title: Atomic Structure
text: An atom consists of a nucleus containing positively charged protons and neutral neutrons, surrounded by negatively charged electrons occupying probabilistic regions called orbitals. The number of protons defines the element (atomic number). Atoms are electrically neutral when protons equal electrons; ions form when electrons are gained or lost. Isotopes are atoms of the same element with different neutron counts. Nearly all of an atom's mass resides in its nucleus, while its volume is mostly empty space.
